tools.name: octadesk_search_tickets
tools.description: Search tickets with optional filters. Returns the page of tickets plus paging fields (total_count, search_id, next_page_url). For the next page, pass the same filters with the returned search_id and page + 1. GET /tickets/search.

tools.name: octadesk_get_ticket
tools.description: Get one ticket by its number, with its fields and status. GET /tickets/{number}.

tools.name: octadesk_get_ticket_interactions
tools.description: List the interactions of one ticket: replies, internal notes and property changes, in order. GET /tickets/{number}/interactions.

tools.name: octadesk_list_requester_tickets
tools.description: List the tickets of one requester. Pass last_number to read past the last ticket of the previous page. GET /tickets.

tools.name: octadesk_list_custom_ticket_lists
tools.description: List the saved custom ticket lists (views) of the account. GET /tickets/custom-lists.

tools.name: octadesk_find_person_by_email
tools.description: Find one person (requester or agent) by exact e-mail address. GET /persons?email=.

tools.name: octadesk_get_person
tools.description: Get one person by id. GET /persons/{id}.

tools.name: octadesk_search_requesters
tools.description: Search requesters (customers who open tickets) by e-mail or name. GET /persons/requesters.

tools.name: octadesk_search_agents
tools.description: Search agents (staff who work tickets) by e-mail or name. GET /persons/agents.

tools.name: octadesk_create_ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket. Common keys of `ticket`: summary, requester ({ email, name } or { id }), idGroupAssigned, idAssigned, idPriority, idCurrentStatus, idSubject, tags (string array), comments ({ internal: { content } } for an agent-only note, { public: { content } } for a reply the requester can read).

tools.name: octadesk_update_ticket
tools.description: Change fields of one ticket, for example status, priority, assignee or group. Send only the fields to change. A `comments.public` entry is e-mailed to the requester. PUT /tickets/{number}.

tools.name: octadesk_create_person
tools.description: Create a person (requester or agent). Send the person fields, for example email and name. POST /persons.

tools.name: octadesk_update_person
tools.description: Change fields of one person. Send only the fields to change. PATCH /persons/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: octadesk_search_tickets, octadesk_get_ticket, octadesk_get_ticket_interactions, octadesk_list_requester_tickets, octadesk_list_custom_ticket_lists, octadesk_find_person_by_email, octadesk_search_requesters, octadesk_search_agents, octadesk_create_ticket · Public sink: octadesk_find_person_by_email, octadesk_create_ticket, octadesk_update_ticket, octadesk_create_person, octadesk_update_person.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: octadesk_search_tickets, octadesk_get_ticket, octadesk_get_ticket_interactions, octadesk_list_requester_tickets, octadesk_list_custom_ticket_lists, octadesk_find_person_by_email, octadesk_search_requesters, octadesk_search_agents, octadesk_create_ticket · Public sink: octadesk_find_person_by_email, octadesk_create_ticket, octadesk_update_ticket, octadesk_create_person, octadesk_update_person

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
